name: Notebuddy
tagline: One companion. A little care, every day.
description:
Raise one AI companion at a time. Feed, play, train and walk together, talk about your day, and keep an illustrated growth album. Your companion is randomly chosen from 9 species and 8 elements. You can explicitly start over with a new random companion, clearing the old progress, chat and portraits.

English by default, with an optional Korean interface and AI replies. Your companion’s name, progress and conversation history stay the same when you switch languages. Daily quests reset at midnight Korea time (UTC+9).

Game rules are evaluated by the original Notebook Pets Python engine; AI dialogue never awards XP or changes stats. Progress, recent chat and saved portraits use Anna Persistent Storage. Walking encounters include a short 2D battle replay. Growth milestones are levels 1, 10, 30 and 50. Only 72 baby pictures are bundled. Evolution automatically creates a new portrait using the previous appearance as a reference. Chat, evolution portraits and optional redraws use your Anna AI allowance. No external API key or ComfyUI installation is required.

First meeting offers random mode or a photo/drawing reference. Optional artwork checking and custom baby generation use Anna AI allowance; retries preserve the assigned species and element. Artwork features and normalized references are retained with the portraits.

Successful care actions automatically trigger short AI chat reactions using your Anna allowance. Care is saved first; delayed or failed reactions never undo gameplay. Received replies can retry saving without another AI request.
